title: Test update migration and rollback on VPS
description: Perform a controlled versioned update, database migration/readiness check, forced failure, and rollback on the approved disposable VPS.
acceptanceCriteria: Update downloads/verifies a pinned artifact without source build and preserves the prior active release
Successful update reaches health, preserves data, and records old/new release manifests
Injected migration/readiness failure automatically restores the prior active release and leaves data intact
Explicit rollback returns to the prior verified release and passes health/readiness

steps.details: Record current release pointer, manifest, database backup checksum, service state, and safe rollback target without secret values.
Update to the candidate pinned artifact, run migration/readiness, and verify data/auth/static assets.
Use a safe fixture/failure flag to make readiness or migration fail, then verify automatic rollback and data integrity.
Select the prior release, restart/readiness-check, and record evidence; clean up only test artifacts afterward.

technicalNotes: Never test rollback against production data or a release that is not already published/verified.
